description.value:
You call forth a crucible of molten iron that pours over the target, burning them as the metal quickly covers and encases their body. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's head is encased in iron, causing them to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] for 1 round and take 1d10 persistent fire damage.

Failure The target's head, arms, and chest are all encased. The target is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 minute or until they Escape. They also take 1d10 persistent fire damage.

Critical Failure The target's legs and feet are also encased. The target is dazzled, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Immobilized] for 1 minute or until they Escape. They also take 1d10 persistent fire damage.

Heightened (+2) The persistent fire damage increases by 1d10.
